verdict.rationale: Productboard's developer docs state directly that developers can "build custom integrations that appear and operate inside the Productboard UI," which matches the story as written. That is the only relevant item, though: it is one sentence that doesn't say what the mechanism is or how it works. missing for 10: name and documentation of the in-UI integration mechanism (e.g. plugin/embed API reference), details on where and how integrations render in the UI, setup or registration steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
